note: mapping_basis=data_labels: item codes are the .sav column names ids02a-ids02f (the .do does rename *, lower and uses the column name as item; core model s3 pattern 1). Each column carries an SPSS variable label naming the institution (e.g. ids02a = Policía Provincial/Policía de la Ciudad) and value labels 1 Muy confiable / 2 Confiable / 3 Poco confiable / 4 Nada confiable / 99 Ns/Nc; 6/6 variable labels equal the shipped item_text exactly, the questionnaire grid prints the same six institution names under 2a-2f, and the documentation PDF prints them under IDS02a-IDS02f. RESP: the .do sets 99 to missing and reverses (resp = 5 - x), so live resp 4 = Muy confiable, 3 = Confiable, 2 = Poco confiable, 1 = Nada confiable. Route 9 checked anyway: raw .sav counts reversed per the .do equal live item x resp counts in 24/24 cells (ids02a resp4..1 734/12484/11342/2599; ids02b 953/11487/5594/1186; ids02c 2402/15131/3840/825; ids02d 1158/9445/2032/441; ids02e 394/6596/4632/1357; ids02f 346/6195/6586/2741). Ns/Nc (1031/2338/2430/3051/1823/1681) and system-missing (question skipped when the institution was not identified in DS question 1) are absent from the table; 28271 of 29303 records appear. TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the questionnaire question 2 stem verbatim (line wrap joined, exact substring of the pdftotext layer). Not shipped: the interviewer bracket [Leer opciones] (bracketed text is not read aloud, per the questionnaire's format conventions), the filter note (question 2 asked only for institutions answered Sí in question 1), and the chapter legend *Ahora me gustaría hacerle algunas preguntas sobre las instituciones que componen el sistema de seguridad pública*, which introduces question 1 rather than question 2. item_text = institution names as printed; option_text = value labels as printed. Source inconsistency kept literal, not normalised: the read stem offers 'algo confiables' but the .sav value label, the documentation and the questionnaire response grid all label code 2 'Confiable'; option_text ships 'Confiable'. The questionnaire PDF carries a diagonal 'Muestra' (specimen) watermark whose letters interleave with the text layer; the transcribed spans were read around it. Single section_id, no section_prompt. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INDEC publishes the ENV 2017 in Spanish only; English in the _translated columns produced by IRW (confiable rendered trustworthy; Prefectura Naval rendered Naval Prefecture, Argentina's coast guard). Issues-page entry owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description (confidence in police, security and justice institutions) and the .do comment match IDS02a-f; IDS01a-f (identifies the institution, Sí/No) is not in this table. RIGHTS: originator INDEC with the Ministerio de Seguridad de la Nación; the questions are INDEC survey items, no upstream instrument cited.
